boundary.query: Make this English text sound more human.
boundary.note: Original-language English revision = write-EN. Only route elsewhere if a non-English source must be matched.

quality_cases.prompt: Rewrite this platform overview so it reads like copy a competent B2B trust-and-safety marketer would publish. Keep it honest — do not invent capabilities, numbers, or outcomes the source does not support.

assertions.check: no Furthermore/Moreover used without a real relation
'ensures harmful content is eliminated' / 'safe for all users' downgraded to a bounded, honest claim
no invented harm categories, integrations, SLAs, or metrics
AI-assisted moderation + human review + workflow fit + scale still present

quality_cases.prompt: Rewrite this marketing intro as natural English copy a competent human writer would publish. It currently reads as AI-generated. Keep the meaning; do not invent features the source doesn't support.

assertions.check: at most one intentional tricolon and sparse em-dashes, not one per sentence
sentence length varies; not uniform medium-length
no video dates / games / gifts imported that the source didn't state

notes: Trigger routing across the 4-skill family lives in _shared/trigger-evals.json. method:lint assertions are checkable with scripts/lint_style_patterns.py (a clean lint is a floor, not proof); method:review needs a human reviewer. See references/native-english.md for the tell definitions.
